profile.headline: Full Stack Engineer | Ruby, Python, JavaScript, Go
profile.summary:
As a Full Stack Engineer at BetterUp, I apply my broad experience in various areas of information systems to design and develop solutions that support the company's mission of transforming people and workplaces through personalized coaching and learning. I have over 6 years of experience in full stack engineering, working with technologies such as Python, Redshift, Scala, Docker, Fastly, and gRPC.

In my previous roles, I have delivered impactful results such as modernizing the data storage and infrastructure, introducing edge caching and dockerization, implementing A/B testing and micro-services, and facilitating integration and roll-out of delivery platforms. I enjoy working across teams and stakeholders to implement features and support for new products and offerings, and to bring about the change and progress they strive to achieve. I am passionate about web development, object oriented programming, and business analysis, and I am always eager to learn new skills and technologies.
